mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will negatively impact corporate earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 1% INDPRO drop, or the signal explains < 5% of return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of periods following a 0.5pp UNRATE rise, or the signal explains < 10% of return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve (10Y-3M spread < 0) signals a coming recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following an inverted yield curve, or the inversion explains < 10% of return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp FEDFUNDS rise, or the signal explains < 5% of return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact corporate earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 2% RSAFS drop, or the signal explains < 5% of return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts signals increased construction activity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a rise in housing starts, or HOUST explains < 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.1) in walk-forward regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market and slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 200k PAYEMS drop, or the signal explains < 5% of return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in walk-forward regression.
